errors.evidence: The description claims that the blue line (wine grapes) stabilizes between 2016 and 2018, but the graph shows a clear upward trend from approximately 5800 kg in 2016 to 6100 kg in 2018.

errors.text_span: се стабилизира около 6000–6200 килограма до 2020 г.
errors.evidence: The description claims that the orange line (dessert grapes) stabilizes between 2018 and 2020. In fact, the graph shows significant fluctuation: the value rises from ~6100 kg in 2018 to ~6400 kg in 2019, then drops sharply to ~5600 kg in 2020. It does not stabilize.
